nodes.speaker: dace
nodes.text: Easy. I'm not here to drag you back.

nodes.speaker: dace
nodes.text: You're the one from Holding Three. The system says you don't exist. It said the same about me an hour ago.

nodes.speaker: dace
nodes.text: Dace. Site security, until I refused an order. Now my badge opens nothing. That card on the floor was mine. Take it.

nodes.speaker: dace
nodes.text: They told us to sweep Holding and 'reconcile the count.' I asked what that meant. Nobody answered, so I walked.

nodes.speaker: dace
nodes.text: Not a talker. Fine. I've had enough talk for one shift.

nodes.speaker: dace
nodes.text: Security's through that door. There's a crew in there that still follows orders. I could watch your back.

nodes.speaker: dace
nodes.text: Then let's not stand around in the steam. Lead the way.

nodes.speaker: dace
nodes.text: I'll be here. Not like I've got anywhere else to be.
